run_PPOAgent_benchmark: run the PPOAgent with a model checkpoint and evaluate it on a Habitat benchmark task
create_PPOAgentConfig: create a PPOAgentConfig dataclass with input type, model path, resolution, and hidden size settings
build_PPOAgent: build a PPOAgent instance that loads a PointNavResNetPolicy model from a checkpoint file
test_PPOAgent_act: test the PPOAgent act method to get navigation actions from simulator observations
review_PPOAgent_reset: review the PPOAgent reset method that initializes recurrent hidden states and action masks
